verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own Business SMS Booster add-on is described as managing customer texts with a shared inbox, templates, and compliance tools. That covers texts to a business number landing in a shared team inbox. The evidence is a single marketing line, it is a paid add-on rather than core, and nothing shows the team can see which member replied. Missing for 10: evidence of reply attribution or agent visibility in the shared inbox, in-depth first-party documentation of the shared SMS inbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
